hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central America, bordering both the Caribbean Sea and the North Pacific Ocean, between Colombia and Costa Rica || interior mostly steep, rugged mountains with dissected, upland plains; coastal plains with rolling hills || strategic location on eastern end of isthmus forming land bridge that connects North and South America; controls the Panama Canal, which links the North Atlantic Ocean with the North Pacific Ocean via the Caribbean Sea || Resources: copper, mahogany forests, shrimp, hydropower || Exports: copper ore, ships, refined petroleum, bananas, fish (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: interior mostly steep, rugged mountains with dissected, upland plains; coastal plains with rolling hills || Central America, bordering both the Caribbean Sea and the North Pacific Ocean, between Colombia and Costa Rica

climate.excerpt: tropical maritime; hot, humid, cloudy; prolonged rainy season (May to January), short dry season (January to May) || occasional severe storms and forest fires in the Darien area

economy.excerpt: upper middle-income Central American economy; increasing Chinese trade; US dollar user; canal expansion fueling broader infrastructure investment; services sector dominates economy; historic money-laundering and illegal drug hub || Exports: copper ore, ships, refined petroleum, bananas, fish (2023) || Industries: construction, brewing, cement and other construction materials, sugar milling

peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Evangelical 55%, Roman Catholic 33.4%, none 10.1%, unspecified 1.5% (2023 est.) || Mestizo (mixed Indigenous and White) 65%, Indigenous 12.3% (Ngabe 7.6%, Kuna 2.4%, Embera 0.9%, Bugle 0.8%, other 0.4%, unspecified 0.2%), Black or African descent 9.2%, Mulatto 6.8%, White 6.7% (2010 est.)
